LLRF.description: Live Load Reduction Factor (LLRF). Fields are driven by the calculation rule (CALC_RULE): rule 0 uses the per-story reduction range (RANGE_MAX/RANGE_MIN), while the applied components and live load cases define which forces are reduced.

CALC_RULE.description: Calculation Rule. Must be 0 or 1 (values outside this range are rejected). 0: reduction uses the per-story RANGE_MAX/RANGE_MIN limits; 1: reduction range fields are ignored.

APPLIED_COMP.description: Applied Components: force components to which the reduction is applied. Enum values are case-insensitive. Use ALL for all components, or any combination of AXIAL, MOMENTS, SHEAR.

LIVE_LOAD_CASES.description: Live Load Case Names. Each name must match an existing load case; at most 5 are used.

REDUCTION_DATA.description: Reduction Data Table: one entry per story defining the tributary area bounds and (for CALC_RULE=0) the reduction range.

STORY.description: Story name. Must match an existing story.

XMIN.description: X Min: minimum X coordinate of the reduction area.

XMAX.description: X Max: maximum X coordinate of the reduction area.

YMIN.description: Y Min: minimum Y coordinate of the reduction area.

YMAX.description: Y Max: maximum Y coordinate of the reduction area.

RANGE_MAX.description: [CALC_RULE=0] Max(Rmax): upper reduction limit. One of 1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6, 0.55, 0.5. Must be greater than or equal to RANGE_MIN.

RANGE_MIN.description: [CALC_RULE=0] Min(Rmin): lower reduction limit. One of 1, 0.95, 0.9, 0.85, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7, 0.65, 0.6, 0.55, 0.5. Must be less than or equal to RANGE_MAX.
